Subject: Question on service credit trigger + tax evidence for order form

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending over the latest order form (attached). A couple of quick commercial clarifications from our side before we route to Procurement:

- Service credit trigger: the draft references a 5% credit if monthly P95 latency exceeds SLA for two consecutive weeks. Can you confirm whether credits are pro-rated per incident or applied as a single monthly credit? BrightCloud needs clarity to model our SLO exposure.
- Tax / reverse charge: we operate under EU reverse-charge in several countries. We need a short note from Redwood confirming you can accept reverse-charge and what evidence Redwood requires to substantiate VAT-free treatment (PO, VAT reg, certificate?).
- Invoice timing: our AR needs invoices to align to end-of-month billing, with Net 30 from invoice date and PO reference on the invoice. Is that practical?

I've attached the OrderForm_v2 that includes two small redlines from our procurement counsel — they are non-material but they intersect with the credit wording and invoicing cadence. Can you loop in Finance / Legal?

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is hoping to push this through this week.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (Finance) and Ben (Legal/commercial ops) to confirm specifics. Initial answers inline below, and we can finalize wording for the order form redline: 

- Service credit mechanics: Redwood applies credits on a monthly basis. If P95 latency exceeds the SLA threshold for two consecutive weeks within the same billing month, we calculate a single pro-rated credit for that month equal to the percentage in the order form applied against that month’s invoice. We do not stack multiple incident credits for the same month. Proposed clause for redline: 
  "If Service Credit eligibility is met for any portion of a Billing Month, Customer shall receive a single, pro-rated credit for that Billing Month equal to the percentage set forth in the Order Form; multiple qualifying incidents within the same Billing Month shall not result in cumulative credits."

- Reverse charge / VAT: we can accept reverse-charge in most EU cases but require evidence: (1) valid customer VAT registration number; (2) copy of PO showing remit/recipient entity; and (3) completed tax certificate if requested by our tax team. Kimberly — can you confirm if Redwood Finance needs the original certificate or a downloadable EU VAT status printout is sufficient?

- Invoice timing & Net 30: We can align invoices to month-end and Net 30 from invoice date. Please confirm the exact PO reference and desired remit entity so we can populate invoice fields correctly.

Jordan — if that sounds acceptable I'll ask Ben to prepare a concise redline to attach to the order form and share the DocuSign link.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

Karthik — quick finance note for the record and to share with BrightCloud: 

1) VAT / reverse-charge evidence: our standard acceptance is:
   - Valid VAT reg number (EU format) on the PO or a separate certificate;
   - Company legal name and billing entity must match the VAT registration;
   - Where requested, a scanned color copy of the VAT certificate is preferred for first-time customers; for renewals a VIES query screenshot is acceptable.

2) Invoicing cadence: we can issue consolidated month-end invoices with itemized lines for the Order Form (monthly recurring + any overage). Net 30 is standard.

3) Service credit application: finance prefers the single, pro-rated monthly credit method (simpler to apply and reconcile). For transparency we recommend adding a cap: "Service Credits payable in an invoice will not exceed the total monthly invoice amount." (helps avoid negative invoices).

Ben — commercial/legal, please draft the short redline for the order form that: (a) codifies the single monthly, pro-rated credit approach; (b) adds the negative-invoice cap; and (c) inserts a brief tax-evidence list. If we accept a VIES screenshot as alternate evidence, call that out so BrightCloud knows the options.

Kimberly Park
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

1) Service Credit language (redline): as Karthik suggested — single pro-rated credit per Billing Month; add cap that credits applied shall not exceed that Billing Month’s invoice amount.

Include a short sentence that Redwood reserves the right to request original/translated documents where required by local tax law.

3) Invoicing timing: Redwood will issue consolidated month-end invoices, Net 30. We will include PO number, BrightCloud remit entity, and VAT references on the invoice.
